title: Hypsographic Demography: Data and Reproducible Analysis Code
description: Derived data and reproducible analysis code supporting the manuscript ‘Hypsographic Demography: Global Population Structure and Change Across Elevation Gradients.’ The archive contains processed data underlying the manuscript figures and principal results, within-country comparisons, sensitivity analyses, Jupyter notebooks, Python processing and plotting scripts, and final manuscript figures. Large source population, elevation, and settlement rasters are not redistributed and are referenced to their original public sources.
